title: Christmas Wishes
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Christmas Wishes,' the office celebrates the holiday season with festive activities, office exchanges, and personal wishes. Andy introduces himself as the first office Santa and shares his wish for everyone to get along with Jessica. The episode features office parties, pranks, and conflicts, including Jim's suspicion of Dwight's attempts to entrap him regarding his bonus, Erin expressing negative feelings about Jessica, and Dwight reporting a porcupine attack. The characters engage in humorous banter, holiday preparations, and gift exchanges, culminating in Andy fulfilling collected office wishes and planning office desk changes and pranks.
